added_papers_note: No new records of its own this round: every surfaced arXiv ID was already catalogued and no platform-only lead resolved to an arXiv record. All 52 additions of 2026-11-04 came from the arXiv API sweeps, including the whole-window variant backfill (2026-09-15 forward) that the 2026-11-02 social round's blind-spot findings motivated.
limitations: WeChat and Weibo cannot be searched natively from this environment; both were covered through web search. jev-x.com and the vendor citation index were read through summarizing fetches, which truncate long pages. X posts cannot be opened directly; leads were followed through web search.
